code: Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020

key_provisions.requirement: Maximum 8 hours/day and 48 hours/week. Maximum with overtime: 60 hours/week. Mandatory 30-minute rest after 5 hours continuous work. Spread-over must not exceed 10.5 hours.
policy_checklist: Must cap working hours at 8 hours/day and 48 hours/week

key_provisions.requirement: 1 day leave per 20 days worked (not 1 per 30). Qualifying threshold: 240 working days in previous year. Maximum accumulation: 30 days. Leave encashment mandatory on termination and retirement.
policy_checklist: Must specify leave accrual as 1 day per 20 days worked
Must allow accumulation up to 30 days
Must provide leave encashment on termination

key_provisions.requirement: Employer must provide safe workplace, safety training in language workers understand, adequate welfare facilities, and incident reporting procedure.
Every establishment with 500+ workers must have a Safety Committee with equal employer-worker representation meeting quarterly.
policy_checklist: Establishments 500+ workers must have Safety Committee

key_provisions.requirement: Women may work night shifts with their consent. Employer must provide safety measures and transport facility.
policy_checklist: Must specify consent requirement for women on night shift
Must document safety measures for women on night shift
